info.name: Ditto Online Streaming API
info.description:
Test collection for Ditto's online streaming mode

**NEW PIPELINE** - Doesn't interfere with existing backend/frontend

request.description: Check if the Ditto online streaming API is ready
Manually initialize the pipeline (optional - auto-initializes on first use)

Generate a video using online streaming mode with short text.

This will return Server-Sent Events (SSE) with progress updates.
Generate a video with longer text to see multiple streaming chunks.

Test with happy emotion (emotion=3)

Emotions:
- 0: Angry
- 1: Disgust
- 2: Fear
- 3: Happy
- 4: Neutral
- 5: Sad
- 6: Surprise
- 7: Contempt
